current_core_conclusions: The periLC is an LC-anchored molecular field with stable 400-500 um composition.
Fine26 molecular populations are spatially heterogeneous and mostly reproducible across AP sections.
R1-R5 discrete domains are preserved and biologically structured; smooth LC-centered spatial gradients add independent information within and beyond them.
Molecular populations differ in soma geometry.
Projection target biases Fine26 mixture rather than uniquely specifying a molecular type.
External references provide confidence-limited context and are kept separate by framework.
